headline: MatchPal Fantasy: Premier League — Gameweek HQ
body: MatchPal Fantasy — Gameweek 11 A free 5-a-side fantasy football game, played right here in the post — no signup, no app, no fee. Gameweek 11 is open. Squads lock at Sat 31 Oct, 17:30 UTC. How it works • Pick 5 players — 1 keeper and 4 outfield, with at least one defender, midfielder and forward • £30m budget, and no more than 2 players from any one club • Name a captain: your captain scores double • Your squad locks when the first match kicks off • Score from goals, assists, clean sheets and a form-rating bonus This league plays: Premier League. This subreddit has its own league table, weekly and for the season. Pick your squad, check the leaderboard and see live gameweek scores in the MatchPal Fantasy post above.
